# Tin tức AI hôm nay

## Tổng hợp
- **[5U AI scales up new digital workforce platform](https://www.ajot.com/news/5u-ai-scales-up-new-digital-workforce-platform)**: 5U AI đang xây dựng AI Workers hiểu biết về hoạt động vận tải và tự động hóa các quy trình logistics phức tạp. Công ty đang mở rộng đội ngũ và hoạt động tại châu Âu.
- **[Senate confirms Jay Clayton as new intelligence czar](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2026/07/28/senate-confirms-jay-clayton-new-intelligence-czar/)**: Thượng viện đã xác nhận Jay Clayton là giám đốc tình báo quốc gia, đánh dấu một sự thay đổi quan trọng trong lãnh đạo.
- **[1,100 AI workers sign letter asking US to support tools that 'pace the frontier of automated AI development'](https://www.businessinsider.com/ai-open-letter-automated-development-2026-7)**: Hơn 1,100 công nhân AI từ các công ty hàng đầu đã ký một bức thư kêu gọi chính phủ Mỹ hỗ trợ các công cụ quản lý phát triển AI tự động.
- **[Survey: AI costs force businesses to shift strategies](https://chainstoreage.com/survey-ai-costs-force-businesses-shift-strategies)**: Một cuộc khảo sát cho thấy 82% lãnh đạo đầu tư vào AI lo ngại về chi phí, dẫn đến nhiều người phải xem xét lại chiến lược AI của họ.
- **[Network agents are “ready” for commercial use, but are telcos? (Analyst Angle)](https://www.rcrwireless.com/20260728/analyst-angle/network-agents-ready-telcos-abi)**: Tiềm năng của AI agentic trong các mạng di động đang được khám phá, với sự tập trung vào việc triển khai thực tế và sự phát triển của kiến trúc 6G.

Nếu bạn cần thêm thông tin hoặc có yêu cầu khác, hãy cho tôi biết!

items.title: 5U AI scales up new digital workforce platform - American Journal of Transportation
items.summary: “We are not building another chatbot that answers questions and disappears, we are building AI Workers that understand freight operations, carry out the work, and capture the reasoning behind every decision, so teams can scale their knowledge as well as their capacity.”. 5U AI works inside existing freight systems and uses multi-agent AI trained for logistics workflows, including the complex exceptions and manual decisions that make forwarding operations difficult to automate with generic AI tools or legacy automation. The company is already live with forwarders and carriers across Europe, including with TCI International Logistics, where its AI Workers are being used across air and ocean freight operations. 5U AI is growing its team as part of the scale-up, with plans to hire across product, engineering, operations, commercial, and customer functions. “AI is one of the most exciting developments logistics has seen for a generation, but its value will depend on people who understand the industry and want to build practical tools that solve real operational problems,” said Abik.

items.title: Senate confirms Jay Clayton as new intelligence czar - The Washington Post
items.summary: # Senate confirms Jay Clayton as new intelligence czar. The Senate confirmed Jay Clayton as director of national intelligence, ending the acting tenure of Bill Pulte, a housing official and Trump loyalist. Jay Clayton appears before the Senate Intelligence Committee earlier this month during a hearing on his nomination to serve as director of national intelligence. The Senate confirmed Jay Clayton as the director of national intelligence Tuesday, ending the tenure of Bill Pulte, a housing official and Trump loyalist, who held the role for more than a month. The 51-to-47 vote was more partisan than expected after Trump nominated Clayton in June. AI & Tech Brief: Reflection AI arrives in Washington. AI & Tech Brief: Anthropic’s army of AI integrators. items.title: 1,100 AI workers sign letter asking US to support tools that 'pace the frontier of automated AI development' - Business Insider
items.summary: # Over 1,100 AI workers sign letter asking US to support tools that 'pace the frontier of automated AI development'. Senior officials at some of the nation's leading AI companies say it's time for the federal government to find a way to put the brakes on AI development if it's needed. "We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development," reads an open letter signed by more than 1,100 AI workers from companies including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta. The letter zeroes in on "automated AI development," which refers to when AI will be capable of developing itself, something the industry calls "Recursive Self-Improvement." Anthropic has shared that its Claude models are quickly approaching that threshold. Look out for an alert in your inbox the next time a new story is published!

items.title: Survey: AI costs force businesses to shift strategies - Chain Store Age
items.summary: The new EY US AI Pulse Survey from Ernst & Young LLP revealed that 82% of senior leaders whose organization is investing in AI say their organization is concerned about AI token usage (units of data AI models use to process the amount of inputs and generate outputs) and related costs. An almost universal 98% of those investing in AI and using tools that require AI tokens say token usage and related costs have caused their organization to reconsider their approach. More than a third (37%) say their organization's AI token usage and related costs have caused their organization to reconsider the scope of their organization's AI rollout by expanding it, compared with 15% considering reducing it. In last year’s EY US AI Pulse Survey, more than a third (35%) of senior leaders whose organizations were investing in AI anticipated spending $10 million or more on AI by this point.

items.title: Network agents are “ready” for commercial use, but are telcos? (Analyst Angle) - RCR Wireless News
items.summary: *Agentic AI is moving from research to implementation, with growing industry consensus that future mobile networks must become AI-native. For the third year running, the AI Core for Agent Communication Network (ACN) Seminar at MWC26 Shanghai showed the potential of intelligent network agents to move beyond theory and toward practical implementation. AI is being incorporated into telco operations, but it is essential that the telco community does not fall behind the enterprise and hyperscaler sector. If this is to be the case, agentic AI has architectural requirements for the 6G core, rather than as a software overlay on legacy network functions. The 6G core is expected to evolve from a comms-centric 5G ‘service-based architecture’ (SBA) toward a more cognitive and intent-driven architecture. The role, resources, and policy access for AI agents are already being discussed across multiple 3GPP SA2 6G architectural key issues, including ‘non-access stratum’ (NAS) – the core control-plane signaling layer between a device and the network core, location services, ‘AI for network’ (AI4NET), remote and near field sensing, and the data framework.
